# BrightTrust — Saudi AI Safety OS

## Overview
BrightTrust (برايت ترست) is an AI safety and governance platform designed specifically for Saudi Arabian enterprises. It acts as a middleware layer between employees and AI models, ensuring every AI request is secure, documented, auditable, and compliant with Saudi regulations.

Founded: 2025
Headquarters: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Website: https://brighttrust.sa
Contact: +966-538-229-013 (WhatsApp) | hello@brighttrust.sa
Twitter: @BrightTrustSA

## Core Product: BrightTrust Kernel
The BrightTrust Kernel is the core engine — similar to QNX in embedded systems — that sits between users and AI models in enterprise environments.

Architecture: Employee → BrightTrust Kernel → AI Models (Gemini/GPT/Claude/Local)
Connected Systems: ERP, CRM, HIS, SharePoint, Excel

## 4 Security Layers

### Layer 1: AI Firewall
- Scans every AI request before it reaches the model
- Automatic PII Redaction (ID numbers, phone, IBAN, patient IDs)
- Data sensitivity classification
- Policy-as-Code customizable per department
- Blocks or sanitizes sensitive data before AI processing

### Layer 2: AI Audit Trail
- Complete logging of every AI interaction (who asked, what was asked, what data was used, which model responded, sources cited)
- Append-only immutable ledger
- SIEM integration for NCA ECC compliance
- Time-stamped with digital signatures
- Supports NCA ECC 2-2024 requirements

### Layer 3: Human Approval Layer
- AI suggests, never decides autonomously
- Risk-based approval workflow (higher risk = more approvals needed)
- Mobile approvals via WhatsApp, Email, SMS
- Smart delegation for out-of-office scenarios
- Critical actions (destruction, inventory deduction, contract approval) require human sign-off

### Layer 4: AI Evidence File
- Automatic PDF audit file for every AI case
- Includes: case summary, data used, sources, risk score, actions taken, approvals, regulatory references
- Digitally signed with SHA-256 hash
- Linked to PDPL/NCA/SFDA/ISO 13485 requirements
- Exportable in auditor-approved format

## Compliance Packs

### PDPL Pack
Personal Data Protection Law compliance. Includes PII masking, consent management, data sharing logs, data subject notifications, compliance reports ready for SDAIA auditors.

### NCA ECC 2-2024 Pack
National Cybersecurity Authority Essential Cybersecurity Controls. Security controls mapped to operations, access logging, data classification, security reports for national authorities.

### SFDA / ISO 13485 Pack
Saudi Food and Drug Authority + ISO 13485 for medical device manufacturers. Quality management, CAPA, rejections, complaints, internal audit tracking.

### Procurement & Tenders Pack (Etimad)
Tender analysis, contract risk assessment, penalty clause detection, conflict of interest checks, supplier compliance.

### Healthcare Pack
Medical archiving, OCR, file summarization with patient data protection and medical approval workflows.

### Finance Pack (SAMA / ZATCA)
Financial controls, Saudi Central Bank and Zakat/Tax compliance, contract analysis, fraud detection, AML compliance.

## Target Sectors
1. Medical Device Manufacturing — QMS AI for rejections, CAPA, auditing per SFDA/ISO 13485
2. Healthcare — Medical archiving, OCR, patient data protection
3. Government — AI compliant with SDAIA and NCA for faster services
4. Procurement & Tenders — Supplier analysis, risk detection, penalty clauses
5. Financial Sector — SAMA/ZATCA compliance, fraud detection, AML
6. Human Resources — Bias-free CV screening with applicant data protection
7. Supply Chain — Risk monitoring, inventory optimization, demand forecasting
8. Education — AI tools for Saudi universities with student data protection

## Deployment Options
- Cloud: Hosted in Saudi Arabia
- Hybrid: Kernel on-premise, AI in cloud
- Air-Gapped: Fully isolated, no external connections — ideal for government and sensitive manufacturing

## Pricing
Custom pricing based on company size, number of users, and compliance packs required. Contact for personalized quote within 24 hours. Special discount for first 10 Saudi companies in the founding program.

- Human Approval on decisions (unique to BrightTrust)
- Evidence File PDF with digital signature (unique to BrightTrust)
- Works under any model (Gemini, GPT, Claude, local models)
- On-Premise + Air-Gapped deployment
